subject: Re: Project Kestrel kickoff: CFQ classification guardrail
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Linnea Yamada leads at 50%, Nikhil Abebe 30% on dataset generation, Maren Zhou 25% on training infra, Yara Jokic 20% on analysis.

Compute: the classifiers are cheap, but the model-negative dataset isn't — we have to rerun the CFQ baselines (LSTM, transformer, universal transformer) with beam scores enabled to harvest negatives across splits. That's the bulk of the ask: 48 GPUs on titan-a100 best-effort for roughly three weeks, then a trickle for classifier training.

Sequencing per the release scripts: baseline decodes land under cfq_model_outputs per split, then create_cls_dataset.sh with the negative-method and hold-out options. The tree-annotated variant additionally needs the xlink mapping file staged in the output dir — Nikhil hit this already; fiddly but understood.

Ivo
